data.fullPrompt: Warm japandi interior, natural materials, soft diffused light, cvwmn interior photograph: Gallery wall of five brushed brass frames with warm botanical prints above bed left, oversized abstract ochre brushstroke art in white oak frame centered above nightstand at 57 inches. Arched brass floor lamp in right corner casting 2700K amber pool across slate blue wall, fiddle leaf fig in woven seagrass basket backlit creating vertical anchor. White oak storage bed centered with six-pillow architecture in cream linen euro shams, rust velvet standard pillows, ochre woven stripe lumbar, cashmere throw in caramel draped diagonally across foot. Brushed brass table lamp with frosted dome on nightstand at 2700K creating diagonal shadow play. Shot on Canon EOS R5 35mm f/2.8 ISO 400. cvwmn, Architectural Digest editorial photograph, photorealistic interior design render.
